question: Which of the following tropical cyclones had hit the western coast of India in May 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tauktae.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cyclone Tauktae**

 
 
• It was the first cyclonic storm of 2021 that emerged from the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• **It hit southern Gujarat on 17 May 2021** and was classified as a Very Severe Cyclonic Storm (VSCS).
 
• It is a tropical cyclone, It has been named by** Myanmar.**
 
• It means** 'gecko', a highly vocal lizard, in the Burmese language. **
